findings: All helper functions, including run, legal_query, publish_normal_packet, timed_normal_batch, audit_merge, and stats_json, remain byte-identical to the reviewed v1 source. Native and posting runtime headers are unchanged.
Each formal method still runs the complete n-query batch and configured repetition count with the unchanged complete normal-output lifetime; no count/parity/oracle logic is in the performance timer.
A fixed monotone uniform query-ID sample is created before any method feedback. For the intended n=10000, audit_n=256 and IDs are unique, in range, and include 0 and 9999.

audit_q copies exactly q[audit_ids[i]]; sample_plain copies all four compared output fields from full_plain at exactly the same source ID: ids, distances, entries, and profile_distances. same(sample_plain,counted) uses corresponding sample rows.

full_plain[0], full_plain[1], and full_plain[2] each run the complete current K/L batch once. Full M5 linear-merge auditing receives the same-point GT full_plain[1] as before and M5 full_plain[2] as after, with the same full query vector and frozen posting table.

Complete n-row ids/distances/entries/profile outputs are retained for all three methods. Count NDC and statistics are explicitly scoped to audit_n rows, with audit_query_ids persisted globally and per point.
No actual algorithm or source-level indexing bug was found in the cost reduction.
report_boundaries: This is SOURCE-only. It certifies neither actual compiled machine identity, runtime parity, actual thread execution, nor performance.
The complete scored Recall output remains n=10000 per method and point. Only plain/count word parity and NDC/PostStats are reduced to the fixed 256-query sample.
Route and graph NDC files contain 256 aligned sample rows, not 10000 rows; downstream analysis must use raw/audit_query_ids.i32 and must label count/NDC/statistics as sampled.
graph_ndc already includes M5 post rescoring dots. total_ndc=route_ndc+graph_ndc; do not add post_dots again.
Full M5 independent linear merge auditing is retained for all 10000 rows and reuses the complete same-K/same-L GT plain packet.
Timed packets are destroyed. This audit does not claim each timed repetition was saved and checked word-for-word.
Warmup_n is a configuration value, with source default256. Root has specified the new protocol uses warmup256; report that condition rather than full-batch warmup.
Original v1 artifacts and source review retain their original identity; v2 does not retroactively change them.
